name: 93428 · Cambria, CA
findings: ZIP 93428 (Cambria) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93428 (Cambria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93428 (Cambria) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
